item_name: Rothco Canvas Crossbody Fanny Pack - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Canvas Crossbody Fanny Pack makes it easy to take gear on-the-go with multiple zipper pockets and an extra-long adjustable shoulder strap that enables various methods of carrying.
description: Rothco’s Canvas Crossbody Fanny Pack makes it easy to take gear on-the-go with multiple zipper pockets and an extra-long adjustable shoulder strap that enables multiple methods of carrying. The front zipper pocket allows for quick access to your keys, cell phone, wallet, and other essentials (measures 7 inches x 3.5 inches x 1.5 inches). A large main zipper pocket and compact back zipper pocket are perfect for storing EDC (everyday carry) items (Main pocket measures 13.5 inches X 5 inches X 3.5 inches, back pocket measures 4.25 inches X 13.5 inches X 0.5 inches). The versatile shoulder fanny pack can be worn as a waist pack or crossbody bag to meet your specific needs. The adjustable shoulder strap extends up to 53 inches for a one-size-fits-most tactical fanny pack, while the quick-release buckle on the shoulder strap makes putting on and taking off the shoulder fanny pack easy. The bag is composed of a durable, naturally water-resistant material composition and measures 13.5 inches X 5 inches X 5 inches.
